problems: Ostrogoths (455-499, Q103122) and Ostrogothic Kingdom (500-560, Q583038) are one people and realm on every page (kingdom founded in Italy 493). The Ostrogoths dossier ends 499 to match Cliopatria; if the Ostrogothic Kingdom dossier starts 493 the two overlap 493-499 and one must be trimmed or merged. kingdom-of-odoacer's 493 dissolve names 'ostrogoths' as counterpart.

Visigothic Kingdom ends 721, not Cliopatria's 723; Cliopatria's 718-723 shape (Septimania plus Galicia, Asturias, Cantabria) is marked wrong and the north-west coast is given to kingdom-of-asturias (row starts 724); the Asturias and Umayyad dossiers must agree. The ostrogothic-kingdom dossier should carry a vassal tint over the Visigothic Kingdom 511-526.

Cliopatria errors found: Vandal Sicily drawn 441-489 (pages: occupation 468-476, Lilybaeum to 491); Vandal Balearics from 439 (page: 455); Rome patch in the 455-457 Vandal shape (a sack of about a fortnight); Ostrogoths in Pannonia 476-489 (pages: Moesia/Epirus 474-488); Ostrogoths 490 shape includes the old Pannonian land.

Page budgets: Visigothic Kingdom 10 pages opened against 9 (Vascones silent); Ostrogoths 6 against 5 (Nedao shared with Rugiland); Vandal Kingdom 5 of 5 (Vandal Kingdom page opened twice); Rugiland 2 of 2.

WebFetch returns a model-written extraction of each page, not raw text; quotation marks in notes carry that extraction's wording and some dates in extractions were flagged by the extractor as absent from the page (e.g. Euric 469 Merida, Theodoric II 457-458, Hermenegild proclamation) and were recorded at lower confidence or left out.
The Visigothic Kingdom page's quoted Visigothic reign list (34 rulers) is partly overlapping (Liuva I and Liuvigild 569-572; Egica and Wittiza 694-702); kept as the page gives them with notes.
